title: error (relay → publisher or viewer)
description: Error report with one of the 15 codes of docs/protocol.md §9.2; `message` is developer-facing English, `details` MUST NOT contain session codes, tokens or scene content.

message.description: Human-readable English for developers, never shown raw to end users (§9.2).

retryable.description: Whether the sender may retry; omitted where §9.2 lists none.

details.description: Machine-readable context (e.g. viewerLimit, retryAfterS, the offending field for BAD_SEQUENCE). The top-level keys code, token, publisherToken and viewerToken are forbidden here (§9.2); the relay never nests credentials deeper, which the schema cannot check.
